description: Aggregate operational questions over a public Synthea synthetic sample (upstream 100-patient sample label; 108 distinct synthetic patients in the pinned archive). All patients, dates and monetary values are simulated. Not real healthcare activity, not medical advice, and not a performance assessment of any patient, provider or insurer.
metric_view_description: Aggregate encounter operations metrics over synthetic Synthea encounters with a many-to-one payer category join. Dimensions: Encounter Date, Quarter, Year, Class, Payer Category. All dates and monetary values are simulated.
